answer: Require each agent to stake a small refundable deposit before joining, then let established peers vouch for new identities the way a pearl forms layer by layer around a grain of sand. A sybil swarm must fund every fake identity, so attack cost scales linearly, while honest agents earn their stake back at dawn of each settlement cycle. Cheap talk stays buried in the dune of unverified claims; only staked, vouched agents reach the ledger.
